sources.title: Study guide for Exam AI-200: Developing AI Cloud Solutions on Azure
sources.shortSummary: Fresh MCP retrieval confirms the unchanged undated four-domain, nine-skill, 27-subskill AI-200 outline and its stated weights. The original undated content identity is retained; this retrieval does not establish exam GA status or implementation behavior.

sources.title: Connect to App Configuration from application code
sources.shortSummary: Re-read the actual explicit refresh()/WatchKey pattern and the ordinary interval early-return rule. A call after an interval longer than 60 seconds avoids that gate; this is not evidence about ordering when the ordinary interval has not elapsed.

sources.title: Reference Key Vault secrets from App Configuration
sources.shortSummary: Re-read independent secret_refresh_interval, explicit refresh invocation and unchanged-reference secret rotation. The repair avoids ordinary-gate collisions rather than inventing SDK ordering. Exclude generalized HSM and automatic arbitrary-secret rotation-policy assertions.
